svg.title: A nurse is reinforcing teaching with a client who has a new colostomy. Which of the following statements by the client indicate an understanding of the teaching?
svg.desc: EMPTYING AT ONE-THIRD TO ONE-HALF FULL PREVENTS THE WEIGHT OF THE POUCH FROM BREAKING THE SEAL, and chewing well, introducing foods singly, maintaining hydration, and limiting known gas- and odor-producing foods are all correct. THE SKIN BARRIER IS CHANGED EVERY 3 TO 7 DAYS, not daily, because frequent removal strips and damages the peristomal skin. The barrier opening should be cut only about 1/8 inch larger than the stoma; a large gap exposes skin to caustic effluent.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Ostomy Teaching
Read the situation
A nurse is reinforcing teaching with a
client who has a new colostomy. Which of
the following statements by the client
indicate an understanding of the teaching?
What fits here
I should empty the pouch when it is about
one-third to one-half full · I will chew
my food thoroughly and add new foods one
at a time · I will drink at least 2 to 3
liters of fluid each…
Why it fits
EMPTYING AT ONE-THIRD TO ONE-HALF FULL
PREVENTS THE WEIGHT OF THE POUCH FROM
BREAKING THE SEAL, and chewing well,
introducing foods singly, maintaining
hydration, and limiting known gas- and
odor-producing foods are all correct.
